preconditions.description: Number of people in the tree is between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the parent list r is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ri <= n for ri in r)
preconditions.description: Each parent index ri is between 0 and n.
Number of queries is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= pi <= n for vi, pi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query pair (vi, pi) has indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The number of output values is equal to the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is an integer.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == count_cousins(vi, pi, r) for i, (vi, pi) in enumerate(queries)
postconditions.description: The i-th output value is the number of pi-th cousins of person vi.
